loc.lakeside.name: Lakeside Lane
loc.lakeside.description: The lane from the market ends at the grey water of the mere. Wooden docks stretch east; reeds crowd the shore to the south.

loc.docks.name: Hollowmere Docks
loc.docks.description: Creaking planks and upturned boats. A rowing boat is tied at the end of the pier, pointed at a dark island far out on the water.

loc.fishers_hut.name: Fisher's Hut
loc.fishers_hut.description: Nets, hooks and a pot of something that was probably fish. It smells like a week ago.

loc.reed_banks.name: Reed Banks
loc.reed_banks.description: Reeds taller than you whisper on every side. Among them, pale flowers float on the still water.

loc.marsh_edge.name: Edge of the Marsh
loc.marsh_edge.description: Firm ground gives way to sucking mud. A path of sunken logs leads south into the bog; the deep woods rise to the west.

loc.bog.name: The Black Bog
loc.bog.description: Bubbles rise and burst with a smell of rot. A crooked hut stands on stilts to the west; the tip of a stone roof pokes out of the mud to the east.

loc.witch_hut.name: Hut on Stilts
loc.witch_hut.description: Dried frogs, bottled fog, a cauldron that is definitely not soup. A cat watches you from the rafters with open contempt.

loc.sunken_shrine.name: Sunken Shrine
loc.sunken_shrine.description: Half a chapel swallowed by the bog. Water laps at the altar steps, and a drowned figure in a wedding dress drifts between the pews.

loc.isle_shore.name: Isle Shore
loc.isle_shore.description: The rowing boat grinds onto black shingle. Crabs the size of shields click among the rocks. Ruins crown the island to the north.

loc.isle_ruins.name: Ruins of the Isle
loc.isle_ruins.description: Broken columns around a cracked bronze bell half-buried in the earth. Someone has made a home among the stones.

item.fish_stew.name: Fish Stew
item.fish_stew.description: Old Pike's stew. Hot, thick and best not examined.

item.bog_moss.name: Bog Moss
item.bog_moss.description: Spongy moss that numbs pain when pressed to a wound.

item.drowned_locket.name: Drowned Locket
item.drowned_locket.description: A tarnished silver locket. Inside, a tiny portrait of a smiling fisherman.

item.ferry_charm.name: Ferryman's Charm
item.ferry_charm.description: A knot of blue cord and a fish bone. Ilsa made it; the ferryman wants you to have it.

item.crab_shell.name: Crab Shell
item.crab_shell.description: A shell as big as a buckler. It will do as one.

item.cracked_bell.name: Cracked Bell
item.cracked_bell.description: The bronze bell of the old watch. Far too heavy, and half-buried besides.

npc.ferryman.name: Ferryman Tobe
npc.ferryman.description: A big man with red eyes and a rope wound around his fist.

start.text: The lake's too calm today. It's been too calm since she drowned.

wife.text: My Ilsa. She went to pray at the old shrine the night the bog swallowed it. They say she still walks there. Her locket... I would give anything to hold it again.

options.text: Sounds like a job for someone else.

kindness.text: ...Thank you. Few folk say it. Most just ask about the boat.

options.text: I'll bring her locket back to you.

promise.text: The shrine is east of the Black Bog, south of the reeds. Whatever walks there now... it isn't her. Don't let it fool you.

boat.text: Take it. Row east to the isle. The hermit there won't bite, the crabs will.

npc.fisher.name: Old Pike
npc.fisher.description: More beard than man, smelling strongly of his trade.
dialogue: Fish aren't biting. Crabs are. Big ones, out on the isle.
Stew's on the fire. Help yourself, it's good for you. Probably.
Tobe hasn't been right since Ilsa. Be gentle with him.

npc.witch.name: Grizelda
npc.witch.description: Sharp nose, sharper eyes, and a hat that has seen things.

start.text: Visitors. How tedious. Speak, or leave the mud where you found it.

home.text: My home, and none of yours. The bog keeps what it takes: carts, bells, brides. Mostly brides, lately.

shrine.text: The thing in the shrine wears Ilsa's dress and Ilsa's locket. It is not Ilsa. Cut it down and the locket is yours. Or leave it, and it will keep walking. Your choice, dearie; I only watch.

lesson.text: Returned what the water took. How rare. Here is a secret for your trouble: the Hollow King fears the sound of bells. The watch knew it. The watch is dead. Make of that what you will.

npc.hermit.name: The Hermit
npc.hermit.description: An old woman in patched robes, sitting against the bell as if it were an armchair.
dialogue: This bell rang every night for a hundred years. Then one night it cracked, and the tower lit up.
The watch lived on this isle. Sir Edric was their captain; he's buried under the chapel now.
Go home, young one. Or go up the hill. Just don't stay here - the crabs get bold after dark.

npc.bog_lurker.name: Bog Lurker
npc.bog_lurker.description: A heap of weed and mud that rises with two burning eyes.

npc.drowned.name: Drowned Bride
npc.drowned.description: Wet hair, a torn wedding dress, and a silver locket at her throat. Her face is not quite a face.

npc.crab.name: Giant Crab
npc.crab.description: A crab as wide as a table, with one claw much bigger than the other.

q.lost_locket.title: The Drowned Locket
q.lost_locket.description: Ferryman Tobe's wife drowned in the sunken shrine. He wants her locket back.

steps.description: Find the sunken shrine, east of the Black Bog.
Lay the Drowned Bride to rest.
Bring the Drowned Locket back to Ferryman Tobe.

bonus.message: "You were kind before you were useful," Tobe says. "I won't forget it."

q.crab_trouble.title: Crabs of the Isle
q.crab_trouble.description: Old Pike can't fish with the giant crab raiding his lines on the isle.
